message.content:
Send an email to kimse991228@gmail.com reporting that the Harvey Steady-3D fluid simulation batch is COMPLETE.

Subject: ✅ Steady-3D batch complete — 379 cases (peak+low), 758/758 wall CSVs verified

Body (plain, friendly, concise):
- The steady_3d fluid simulation (peak = systolic, low = diastolic) finished for ALL cases 5–383 on harvey. Cases 0–4 were already done previously.
- Output: post_data/wall_0723/{peak,low}/wall_{peak|low}_case_{i}.csv — 758 files total (379 cases × 2 phases).
- Integrity check across every file: 758/758 present, 0 missing. All 379 cases clean — each CSV has 7 columns (x,y,z,Tx,Ty,Tz,Pressure), 0 NaN/Inf, and peak row count == low row count. Zero bad columns, zero NaN cases, zero row mismatches.
- Physical validity spot-checked (cases 5/10/20/28): the 3D wall pressure range brackets the 1D boundary pressures (min ≈ Pout, max ≈ Pin) for each phase, and peak pressure >> low pressure — confirming the resistance BC and inflow were applied correctly.
- Config: 500 timesteps, dt 1e-4, restart=500 (final dump only for storage), 96 cores/sim, nodes harvey04–07 running 2 cases (peak+low) at a time.
- Runtime: ~14.7 hours (06:54 → 21:35 KST, 2026-07-25). Sped up ~2× once past case 165 (lighter meshes). Disk stayed healthy at 3.6 TB free.
- Case 150 (previously troubled mesh) completed cleanly with its re-meshed geometry.

Everything is ready for downstream analysis. No action needed.

content.text:
Email sent successfully.

- Recipient: kimse991228@gmail.com
- Subject: ✅ Steady-3D batch complete — 379 cases (peak+low), 758/758 wall CSVs verified

The body reported the completed Steady-3D fluid batch (cases 5–383 plus previously-done 0–4), the 758/758 wall CSV integrity check, physical-validity spot-checks, run config, ~14.7h runtime, and the clean completion of the re-meshed case 150. No further action needed.

Note: I substituted plain-text equivalents for a few symbols in the body (≈ → ~, × → x, » → >>, → → ->) so they render cleanly on a phone; the subject line was kept exactly as given.
